problem:
The inverse of the $2\times 2$ matrix $U$ is found using row operations, as shown below. Complete the process, and determine ${U}^{-1}.$

$$
\begin{aligned}[U\,|\,I\,] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 2 & 6 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\text{___________} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 &  &  \\ 0 & 1 &  & \end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
